zh: 今天比昨天忙多了。
en: Today's way busier than yesterday.
alt: Today's much busier than yesterday.
point: …多了 → way / much + 比较级，不是 busier much

zh: 我的工作跟他的差不多。
en: My job's pretty similar to his.
alt: My job's much the same as his.
point: 差不多 → similar to，不是 almost same

zh: 这台笔记本没有我以前那台快。
en: This laptop isn't as fast as my old one.
alt: This laptop's slower than my old one.
point: 没有…快 → isn't as fast as

zh: 这是最新版吗？
en: Is this the latest version?
alt: Is this the most recent version?
point: 最新版 → the latest version，不说 the newest

zh: 这一带就数这家的炸鱼薯条最好吃。
en: This place has the best fish and chips around here.
alt: This place does the best fish and chips around.
point: 最好吃 → the best，不说 the most delicious

zh: 比起咖啡，我更喜欢喝茶。
en: I prefer tea to coffee.
alt: I'd rather have tea than coffee.
point: 更喜欢 A → prefer A to B，不是 prefer A than B

zh: 他跑得比我快。
en: He's faster than me.
alt: He runs faster than I do.
point: 比我快 → faster than me，不说 more fast

zh: 今年的球队比去年强一点。
en: This year's team is a bit stronger than last year's.
alt: The team's a bit better this year than last year.
point: 强一点 → a bit stronger；last year's 的 's 别漏

zh: 这个跟那个一样贵。
en: This one's just as expensive as that one.
alt: This one costs the same as that one.
point: 一样贵 → as expensive as，不是 same expensive

zh: 这双鞋比那双舒服。
en: These shoes are more comfortable than those.
alt: This pair's more comfortable than that pair.
point: 长形容词 → more comfortable，不说 comfortabler

zh: 坐火车比开车慢。
en: Taking the train is slower than driving.
alt: The train's slower than driving.
point: 比较双方要对称：taking the train 对 driving

zh: 惠灵顿的风比奥克兰大多了。
en: Wellington's a lot windier than Auckland.
alt: It's much windier in Wellington than in Auckland.
point: 风大 → windy，比较级 windier，不说 wind is bigger

zh: 我今天感觉好多了。
en: I'm feeling much better today.
alt: I feel a lot better today.
point: 好多了 → much better，不说 more better

zh: 他是我们办公室身体最好的。
en: He's the fittest person in our office.
alt: He's the fittest one in the office.
point: 身体最好 → the fittest，不是 the best body

zh: 新房子比原来的大一倍。
en: The new house is twice as big as the old one.
alt: Our new place is double the size of the old one.
point: 大一倍 → twice as big as，不是 one time bigger

zh: 楼上比楼下暖和。
en: It's warmer upstairs than downstairs.
alt: Upstairs is warmer than downstairs.
point: 句子要有主语 it；暖和 → warmer than

zh: 他跟他哥哥长得一模一样。
en: He looks exactly like his brother.
alt: He looks just the same as his brother.
point: 长得一样 → looks exactly like，不是 looks same

zh: 人越多越热闹！
en: The more, the merrier!
alt: The more people, the better!
point: 越多越好 → the more, the merrier，固定说法

zh: 这个月花得比上个月少。
en: I've spent less this month than last month.
alt: I've spent less this month than I did last month.
point: 花得少 → spent less than，钱不可数用 less

zh: 这张卡的利息最高。
en: This card has the highest interest rate.
alt: This card charges the most interest.
point: 最高 → the highest，最高级前加 the

zh: 新系统比旧的好用多了，就是得花点时间适应。
en: The new system's way easier to use than the old one, but it takes getting used to.
alt: The new system's much more user-friendly than the old one, though it takes a while to get used to.
point: 好用多了 → much easier to use than

zh: 这次的截止日期比我们想的要早。
en: The deadline for this one is earlier than we thought it'd be.
alt: This deadline's earlier than we expected.
point: 比想的早 → earlier than we thought

zh: 云服务器的费用是本地服务器的三倍。
en: The cloud servers cost three times as much as the ones on site.
alt: Cloud hosting is three times more expensive than our on-site servers.
point: 是…的三倍 → three times as much as

zh: 这两个方案差别不大，选哪个都行。
en: There's not much difference between the two options, so either's fine.
alt: The two options are pretty similar, so either one will do.
point: 差别不大 → not much difference between

zh: 这家的分量比我们上次去的那家大多了。
en: The portions here are way bigger than at the place we went to last time.
alt: You get much bigger portions here than at the place we tried last time.
point: 比较对象要对齐：portions here 对 at the place

zh: 这道菜没看上去那么辣，你可以尝尝。
en: It's not as spicy as it looks, so you should give it a try.
alt: It's not as hot as it looks. Give it a go.
point: 没看上去那么 → not as…as it looks

zh: 我现在游得没以前快了，可能是太久没练了。
en: I can't swim as fast as I used to. I'm probably out of practice.
alt: I'm not as quick in the pool as I used to be, probably because I'm out of practice.
point: 没以前快 → not as fast as I used to

zh: 对我来说，去现场看比在电视上看有意思多了。
en: For me, watching it live is way more fun than watching it on TV.
alt: I find going to the game much more fun than watching it on TV.
point: 有意思多了 → way more fun，fun 用 more

zh: 在网上买一般比在店里买便宜一点。
en: It's usually a bit cheaper to buy online than in store.
alt: Buying online is usually a little cheaper than buying in store.
point: 便宜一点 → a bit cheaper；online 对 in store

zh: 这两件看着一样，但这件的料子好很多。
en: These two look the same, but this one's made of much better fabric.
alt: They look identical, but the material on this one is far better.
point: 看着一样 → look the same；好很多 → much better

zh: 皇后镇的物价比奥克兰还贵，尤其是住宿。
en: Queenstown's even more expensive than Auckland, especially for accommodation.
alt: Things cost even more in Queenstown than in Auckland, especially places to stay.
point: 比…还贵 → even more expensive than，even 加强比较

zh: 这是我住过的最舒服的酒店。
en: This is the most comfortable hotel I've ever stayed in.
alt: This is the comfiest hotel I've ever stayed at.
point: 住过最…的 → the most…I've ever stayed in

zh: 我的血压比上次高了一点，所以我在少吃盐。
en: My blood pressure's slightly higher than last time, so I'm cutting back on salt.
alt: My blood pressure's gone up a bit since last time, so I'm eating less salt.
point: 高了一点 → slightly higher than last time

zh: 走路上班跟去健身房一样能锻炼身体。
en: Walking to work is just as good for you as going to the gym.
alt: Walking to work is as good a workout as going to the gym.
point: 一样能 → just as good for you as

zh: 我们现在的房租只有住市中心时候的一半。
en: Our rent's half what we paid when we lived in the CBD.
alt: We pay half the rent we did when we lived in the city centre.
point: 只有…一半 → half what we paid，不说 cheaper half

zh: 你房间越来越乱了，赶紧收拾一下。
en: Your room's getting messier and messier, so you need to tidy it up.
alt: Your room keeps getting messier. Can you give it a tidy?
point: 越来越 → 比较级 and 比较级

zh: 他比我想象的好相处多了。
en: He's much easier to get along with than I thought.
alt: He's a lot easier to get on with than I expected.
point: 比想象的 → than I thought；好相处 → easy to get along with

zh: 我们俩现在的爱好跟以前很不一样了。
en: Our interests are quite different from what they used to be.
alt: We're into really different things now compared to before.
point: 跟…不一样 → different from，不是 different with

zh: 在新西兰，租房和买房哪个更划算？
en: Is it better to rent or to buy in New Zealand?
alt: In New Zealand, which makes more sense, renting or buying?
point: 哪个更划算 → Is it better to A or B？

zh: 我的工资涨得没物价快。
en: My pay isn't going up as fast as the cost of living.
alt: My wages aren't keeping up with the cost of living.
point: 没有…快 → not as fast as；物价 → cost of living

zh: 跟上个季度比，我们的销售额涨了将近百分之二十，比预期好得多。
en: Compared to last quarter, our sales are up nearly twenty percent, which is far better than we'd forecast.
alt: Sales are up almost twenty percent on last quarter, which is well ahead of what we forecast.
point: 跟…比 → compared to；好得多 → far better than

zh: 这个方案虽然比另一个贵一点，但从长远看能省下更多时间和人力。
en: This option's a bit pricier than the other one, but in the long run it'll save us a lot more time and effort.
alt: This option costs slightly more than the other, but long term it'll save us much more time and work.
point: 贵一点 → a bit pricier；更多 → a lot more

zh: 我们测了一下，新架构的响应速度是原来的两倍，出错率也低了很多。
en: We ran some tests, and the new setup responds twice as fast as the old one, with a much lower error rate.
alt: Our tests show the new architecture is twice as fast as the old one and throws far fewer errors.
point: 两倍快 → twice as fast as；低很多 → much lower

zh: 与其每次都手动部署，不如花点时间把流程自动化，越早做越好。
en: Rather than deploying manually every time, we'd be better off automating the process, and the sooner, the better.
alt: Instead of deploying by hand every time, we should take the time to automate it, the sooner the better.
point: 与其…不如 → we'd be better off；越早越好 → the sooner, the better

zh: 说实话，那家新开的店没大家说的那么好，我还是更喜欢街角那家。
en: To be honest, the new place isn't as good as everyone says. I still prefer the one on the corner.
alt: Honestly, the new place doesn't live up to the hype. I still like the one on the corner better.
point: 没…说的那么好 → isn't as good as everyone says

zh: 这里的平白比我在国内喝过的任何一杯咖啡都顺滑。
en: The flat whites here are smoother than any coffee I've ever had back home.
alt: The flat whites here are smoother than anything I ever had back home.
point: 比任何…都 → 比较级 + than any

zh: 他今年的状态是我见过最好的，比他刚进队的时候稳多了。
en: He's in the best form I've ever seen him, and he's far more consistent than when he first joined the team.
alt: This is the best I've ever seen him play, and he's much more consistent than when he first joined.
point: 最好的状态 → the best form；稳多了 → far more consistent than when

zh: 跟橄榄球比起来，板球节奏慢得多，但现场气氛其实一点也不差。
en: Compared with rugby, cricket feels a lot slower, but the atmosphere at the ground is every bit as good.
alt: Cricket's much slower than rugby, but the atmosphere at the ground is just as good.
point: 一点也不差 → every bit as good；慢得多 → a lot slower

zh: 我比了几家店的价格，New World的牛奶比Countdown贵了将近一块钱。
en: I compared prices at a few shops, and milk at New World is nearly a dollar more than at Countdown.
alt: I checked a few supermarkets, and milk costs almost a dollar more at New World than at Countdown.
point: 贵一块钱 → a dollar more than，差额放在 more 前

zh: 这台吸尘器虽然最贵，但吸力最强，噪音也比别的小很多。
en: This vacuum's the most expensive one, but it's also the most powerful and much quieter than the others.
alt: This vacuum costs the most, but it's got the strongest suction and it's way quieter than the rest.
point: 最贵/最强 → the most…；小很多 → much quieter than

zh: 这次自驾比上次跟团玩得开心多了，想在哪儿停就在哪儿停。
en: We enjoyed this road trip far more than the tour we did last time, because we could stop wherever we liked.
alt: This road trip was heaps better than the tour last time, since we could stop wherever we wanted.
point: 玩得开心多了 → enjoyed…far more than

zh: 机票越早订越便宜，所以我们一般提前三个月就订好了。
en: The earlier you book flights, the cheaper they are, so we usually book about three months ahead.
alt: Flights get cheaper the earlier you book, so we normally book three months out.
point: 越…越… → the earlier…, the cheaper…

zh: 我现在比以前睡得早多了，白天精神也好了很多。
en: I'm going to bed much earlier than I used to, and I've got way more energy during the day.
alt: I go to bed a lot earlier than I used to, and I feel much more awake during the day.
point: 早多了 → much earlier than I used to；精神好 → more energy

zh: 这种新药比以前那种副作用少多了，而且一天只要吃一次。
en: This new medication has a lot fewer side effects than the old one, and you only have to take it once a day.
alt: The new medicine causes far fewer side effects than the old one, and it's just once a day.
point: 副作用少 → fewer side effects，可数名词用 fewer

zh: 我们把旧电暖器换成了热泵，屋里比以前暖和多了，电费也省了。
en: We replaced the old heaters with a heat pump, and the house is way warmer and cheaper to run than before.
alt: Since we swapped the old heaters for a heat pump, the house is much warmer and the power bill's lower.
point: 比以前暖和、省钱 → warmer and cheaper to run than before

zh: 跟公寓比，独立屋空间大得多，但要打理的事也多得多。
en: A standalone house gives you heaps more room than an apartment, but there's a lot more upkeep too.
alt: You get much more space in a standalone house than an apartment, but there's far more maintenance.
point: 多得多 → heaps more / a lot more；heaps 是新西兰口语

zh: 他的英语比我好太多了，可他说他刚来的时候跟我现在差不多。
en: His English is miles better than mine, but he says when he first arrived it was about the same as mine is now.
alt: His English is way better than mine, but he reckons it was about where mine is now when he first got here.
point: 好太多 → miles better than；差不多 → about the same as

zh: 比起一大帮人聚会，我更喜欢跟几个好朋友安安静静吃顿饭。
en: I'd much rather have a quiet dinner with a few close mates than go to a big party.
alt: I prefer a quiet meal with a few good friends to a big party.
point: 宁愿 A 不愿 B → I'd rather A than B，A、B 都用原形

zh: 现在定期存款的利率还不如通胀高，钱放着其实是在贬值。
en: Term deposit rates are lower than inflation right now, so your savings are actually losing value.
alt: Right now term deposits pay less than inflation, so your money's actually shrinking in real terms.
point: 还不如…高 → lower than，中文否定比较转成肯定比较级

zh: 跟去年这个时候比，我们家每周买菜多花了大概五十块。
en: We're spending about fifty dollars more a week on groceries than we were this time last year.
alt: Compared with this time last year, our weekly grocery bill is up by about fifty dollars.
point: 多花五十块 → fifty dollars more…than；比较对象 this time last year

zh: 今天的会比平时短。
en: Today's meeting was shorter than usual.
alt: The meeting today didn't go as long as normal.
point: 比平时 → than usual，不说 than normal time

zh: 我的手机比你的旧。
en: My phone's older than yours.
alt: My phone isn't as new as yours.
point: 比你的 → than yours，用 yours 不用 you

zh: 这杯比刚才那杯甜多了。
en: This one's much sweeter than the last one.
alt: This cup's way sweeter than the one before.
point: 甜多了 → much sweeter；刚才那杯 → the last one

zh: 他是我们队里个子最高的。
en: He's the tallest in our team.
alt: He's the tallest player on our team.
point: 队里最高 → the tallest in/on our team，不用 of

zh: 今天店里的人比周末少。
en: There are fewer people here today than at the weekend.
alt: The shop's quieter today than at the weekend.
point: 人少 → fewer people，可数名词用 fewer 不用 less

zh: 走这条路最近。
en: This is the quickest way.
alt: This route's the shortest.
point: 最近的路 → the quickest/shortest way，不说 the nearest road

zh: 我的牙比上周更疼了。
en: My tooth hurts even more than last week.
alt: My tooth's worse than it was last week.
point: 更疼 → hurts more，动词后直接加 more

zh: 厨房是家里最冷的地方。
en: The kitchen's the coldest room in the house.
alt: The kitchen's the coldest part of the house.
point: 家里最冷 → the coldest room in the house

zh: 她比我小两岁。
en: She's two years younger than me.
alt: She's two years younger than I am.
point: 小两岁 → two years younger，数字放在比较级前

zh: 这个套餐比那个划算。
en: This deal's better value than that one.
alt: This one's a better deal than that one.
point: 划算 → better value / a better deal，不说 more worth

zh: 这份工作的工资比我现在的高。
en: This job pays more than my current one.
alt: The salary for this job is higher than what I'm on now.
point: 工资高 → pays more，直接用动词 pay

zh: 我的经验没有他多。
en: I don't have as much experience as him.
alt: I've got less experience than him.
point: 经验没他多 → not as much experience as，经验不可数

zh: 那是我面过最难的一次。
en: That was the hardest interview I've ever had.
alt: That was the toughest interview I've ever done.
point: 面过最难的 → the hardest…I've ever had

zh: 这次考试比上次难。
en: This exam was harder than the last one.
alt: This test was more difficult than the last.
point: 上次的 → the last one；难 → harder

zh: 对我来说，语法比口语容易一点。
en: For me, grammar's a bit easier than speaking.
alt: I find grammar slightly easier than speaking.
point: 容易一点 → a bit easier，不说 a little easy

zh: 她是班上英语最好的。
en: Her English is the best in the class.
alt: She's got the best English in our class.
point: 英语最好 → her English is the best，不说 she is best English

zh: 这套房比上一套亮堂多了。
en: This flat's much brighter than the last one.
alt: This place gets way more light than the last one.
point: 亮堂 → bright；多了 → much brighter

zh: 这里的房租跟我们现在的差不多。
en: The rent here's about the same as ours.
alt: The rent here's similar to what we pay now.
point: 差不多 → about the same as，不说 almost same

zh: 两间卧室一样大。
en: Both bedrooms are the same size.
alt: The two bedrooms are just as big as each other.
point: 一样大 → the same size，不说 same big

zh: 隔壁的狗比以前安静了。
en: The dog next door's quieter than it used to be.
alt: Next door's dog isn't as noisy as it was.
point: 比以前 → than it used to be，别只说 than before

zh: 他们家的院子比我们的大得多。
en: Their section's way bigger than ours.
alt: Their backyard's much bigger than ours.
point: 比我们的 → than ours，不说 than us；院子 → section

zh: 这条街上数他家的圣诞灯最亮。
en: Their Christmas lights are the brightest on the street.
alt: They've got the brightest Christmas lights on the street.
point: 街上最亮 → the brightest on the street，介词用 on

zh: 这个月的电费比上个月高多了。
en: This month's power bill is much higher than last month's.
alt: The power bill's way up on last month.
point: 电费高 → a higher bill；last month's 的 's 别漏

zh: 光纤比我们以前的网快多了。
en: Fibre's way faster than our old internet.
alt: Fibre's much quicker than the broadband we had before.
point: 快多了 → way faster；fibre 用英式拼写

zh: 这个套餐的流量是那个的两倍。
en: This plan gives you twice as much data.
alt: You get double the data on this plan.
point: 两倍流量 → twice as much data，data 不可数用 much

zh: 第二个报价比第一个便宜。
en: The second quote was cheaper than the first.
alt: The second quote came in lower than the first one.
point: 报价 → quote；便宜 → cheaper，不说 more cheap

zh: 买个新的比修旧的还便宜。
en: Buying a new one is cheaper than fixing the old one.
alt: It's cheaper to buy a new one than to fix the old one.
point: 比较双方都用 -ing：buying…than fixing

zh: 漏水比昨天更严重了。
en: The leak's worse than yesterday.
alt: The leak's got worse since yesterday.
point: 更严重 → worse，bad 的比较级不规则

zh: 网上申请比去现场办快。
en: Applying online is quicker than going in person.
alt: It's faster to apply online than in person.
point: 去现场 → in person；比较双方要对称

zh: 今天排队的人没上次多。
en: The queue isn't as long as last time.
alt: There's a shorter queue than last time.
point: 排队人没那么多 → the queue isn't as long，英文说队伍长短

zh: 这次办护照比上次贵一点。
en: My passport cost a bit more this time.
alt: Renewing my passport was a bit dearer than last time.
point: 贵一点 → cost a bit more，用动词 cost 更自然

zh: 这次地震比上次的强。
en: This earthquake was stronger than the last one.
alt: This quake was bigger than the last one.
point: 地震强 → stronger / bigger，不说 more strong

zh: 风越刮越大了。
en: The wind's getting stronger and stronger.
alt: The wind keeps picking up.
point: 越刮越大 → stronger and stronger，比较级叠用

zh: 打111是最快的办法。
en: Calling 111 is the fastest way.
alt: The quickest thing is to ring 111.
point: 最快 → the fastest，不说 the most fast

zh: 早上比晚上堵多了。
en: Traffic's much worse in the morning than in the evening.
alt: The morning traffic is way heavier than the evening.
point: 堵 → traffic is bad，堵得多 → much worse

zh: 坐公交跟开车差不多快。
en: The bus is about as quick as driving.
alt: Taking the bus is nearly as fast as driving.
point: 差不多快 → about as quick as，about 放在 as 前

zh: 这辆车比我那辆省油。
en: This car uses less petrol than mine.
alt: This car's more fuel-efficient than mine.
point: 省油 → uses less petrol，不可数用 less

zh: 今天比昨天暖和多了。
en: It's a lot warmer today than yesterday.
alt: Today's much warmer than yesterday.
point: 说天气要加主语 it；暖和多了 → a lot warmer

zh: 这条步道比看起来难走。
en: This track's harder than it looks.
alt: This walk is tougher than it looks.
point: 比看起来难 → harder than it looks；步道 → track

zh: 北岛的冬天没南岛那么冷。
en: North Island winters aren't as cold as South Island ones.
alt: The North Island has milder winters than the South.
point: 没那么冷 → aren't as cold as；后面用 ones 代替 winters

zh: 原著比电影好看。
en: The book's better than the film.
alt: The book's better than the movie.
point: 好看 → better，不说 more good-looking

zh: 现场听比录音好听多了。
en: Live music sounds way better than recordings.
alt: Music sounds much better live than recorded.
point: 好听 → sounds better，用感官动词 sound

zh: 能比上次再剪短一点吗？
en: Can you go a bit shorter than last time?
alt: Could you cut it a little shorter than last time?
point: 剪短一点 → go a bit shorter，理发常用 go

zh: 今年的圣诞节比去年热闹。
en: This Christmas was livelier than last year's.
alt: Christmas was busier this year than last year.
point: 热闹 → lively，比较级 livelier（y 变 i）

zh: 这是我收到过最好的礼物。
en: This is the best present I've ever got.
alt: This is the best gift I've ever been given.
point: 收到过最好的 → the best…I've ever got

zh: 对我们来说，春节比圣诞节重要。
en: Chinese New Year matters more to us than Christmas.
alt: For us, Chinese New Year is more important than Christmas.
point: 重要 → matters more，动词 matter + more

zh: 我儿子已经比我高了。
en: My son's already taller than me.
alt: My boy's taller than me now.
point: 已经比我高 → already taller than me，口语用 me

zh: 她跟她妈妈一样爱说话。
en: She's just as chatty as her mum.
alt: She talks just as much as her mum does.
point: 一样爱说话 → as chatty as；妈妈 → mum

zh: 老二比老大好带多了。
en: Our second's much easier than our first.
alt: Our younger one's way easier to look after than the older one.
point: 好带 → easy，不是 good to bring；老二 → our second

zh: 猫比狗好养。
en: Cats are easier to look after than dogs.
alt: Cats are less work than dogs.
point: 好养 → easier to look after

zh: 我们家的狗是公园里最小的。
en: Our dog's the smallest one at the park.
alt: Ours is the tiniest dog at the park.
point: 公园里最小 → the smallest at the park

zh: 它现在吃得比以前少。
en: She's eating less than she used to.
alt: She doesn't eat as much as she used to.
point: 吃得少 → eating less；宠物常用 he/she 而不是 it

zh: 我现在比以前开心多了。
en: I'm much happier than I used to be.
alt: I'm a lot happier now than I was before.
point: 开心多了 → much happier，不说 more happy much

zh: 这比我想的还难受。
en: This hurts more than I expected.
alt: This is harder than I thought it'd be.
point: 比想的还 → more than I expected

zh: 跟他说话就像对着墙说。
en: Talking to him is like talking to a brick wall.
alt: Talking to him is like talking to a wall.
point: 就像 → is like，比喻用 like 不用 as

zh: 这个月加班比上个月少多了，终于能按时下班了。
en: I've done way less overtime this month than last, so I'm finally getting out on time.
alt: I've worked much less overtime this month than last month, so I can finally leave on time.
point: 加班少 → less overtime，overtime 不可数

zh: 换了固态硬盘以后，电脑开机时间只有以前的一半。
en: Since I put in an SSD, my laptop takes half as long to start up.
alt: Since I swapped in an SSD, my laptop boots up twice as fast.
point: 时间只有一半 → takes half as long to…

zh: 我们点的菜比别的桌上得慢多了，是不是把我们忘了？
en: Our food's taking way longer than the other tables'. Have they forgotten us?
alt: We're waiting much longer than the other tables. Did they forget our order?
point: 上得慢 → taking longer；the other tables' 所有格

zh: 健身房早上的人没晚上多，所以我一般六点就去。
en: The gym's quieter in the morning than at night, so I usually go at six.
alt: The gym's not as busy in the morning as in the evening, so I go at six.
point: 人没那么多 → quieter / not as busy，不说 people less

zh: 这件大了一号，有没有小一号的？
en: This one's a size too big. Have you got it in a smaller size?
alt: This is one size too big. Do you have it a size down?
point: 大一号 → a size too big；小一号 → a smaller size

zh: 回程的机票比去的时候贵了一倍多。
en: The flight back cost more than twice as much as the flight over.
alt: The return flight was over double the price of the flight out.
point: 贵一倍多 → more than twice as much as

zh: 这个药跟那个成分一样，只是便宜一些。
en: This one's got the same active ingredient as that one, but it's a bit cheaper.
alt: This is the same medicine as that one, just a bit cheaper.
point: 成分一样 → the same ingredient as，same 前要 the

zh: 你信吗？用洗碗机比手洗还省水。
en: Believe it or not, the dishwasher uses less water than washing by hand.
alt: Believe it or not, a dishwasher uses less water than doing the dishes by hand.
point: 省水 → uses less water；比较对象 washing by hand

zh: 你一点都没变，跟十年前一模一样！
en: You haven't changed a bit. You look exactly the same as ten years ago!
alt: You haven't changed at all. You look just like you did ten years ago!
point: 跟…一模一样 → exactly the same as

zh: 我看了几家，这家银行的手续费是最低的。
en: Of all the banks I looked at, this one has the lowest fees.
alt: This bank charges the lowest fees of all the ones I checked.
point: 所有…里最低 → of all…, the lowest

zh: 这个职位要求的经验比我想的少，我觉得可以试试。
en: This role needs less experience than I thought, so I reckon I'll give it a go.
alt: The job doesn't need as much experience as I expected, so I might apply.
point: 要求经验少 → needs less experience than I thought

zh: 跟上一份工作比，这份离家近多了。
en: Compared to my last job, this one's much closer to home.
alt: This job's a lot closer to home than my last one.
point: 离家近 → closer to home，不说 nearer from home

zh: 我觉得第二轮面试比第一轮轻松。
en: I found the second interview more relaxed than the first.
alt: The second interview felt more relaxed than the first one.
point: 我觉得…轻松 → I found it more relaxed，find + 宾语 + 形容词

zh: 网课没有面授效果好，但时间更灵活。
en: Online classes aren't as effective as face-to-face ones, but they're more flexible.
alt: Online courses don't work as well as in-person ones, but they're more flexible.
point: 效果没那么好 → aren't as effective as；ones 代替 classes

zh: 考试周的时候图书馆比平时挤多了。
en: The library's way more crowded during exam week than usual.
alt: The library's much busier than normal during exam week.
point: 比平时挤 → more crowded than usual

zh: 我的写作分数比阅读低了整整一分。
en: My writing score was a whole band lower than my reading.
alt: I got a full band lower in writing than in reading.
point: 低一分 → a band lower，差距放在比较级前

zh: 这个房东比上一个靠谱多了，有事马上回复。
en: This landlord's far more reliable than the last one. He gets back to you straight away.
alt: This landlord's much more dependable than our last one, and he replies straight away.
point: 靠谱 → reliable；多了 → far more

zh: 这套带家具的比那套不带的每周贵五十块。
en: This furnished flat is fifty dollars a week more than the unfurnished one.
alt: The furnished place costs fifty bucks more a week than the unfurnished one.
point: 每周贵五十 → fifty dollars a week more than

zh: 反正就我们两个人，房子越小越好。
en: It's just the two of us, so the smaller the place, the better.
alt: There's only two of us, so a smaller place suits us better.
point: 越小越好 → the smaller, the better

zh: 新搬来的邻居比原来那家友好多了，还送了我们饼干。
en: The new neighbours are much friendlier than the old ones. They even brought us biscuits.
alt: Our new neighbours are way friendlier than the last lot. They even dropped off some biscuits.
point: 友好多了 → much friendlier；饼干 → biscuits

zh: 我们这条街的车位越来越难找了。
en: It's getting harder and harder to find a park on our street.
alt: Finding a park on our street is getting harder all the time.
point: 越来越难 → harder and harder；车位 → a park

zh: 社区群里最活跃的就是住拐角的那位阿姨。
en: The most active person in our community group is the lady on the corner.
alt: The lady on the corner is the most active one in our community group.
point: 最活跃 → the most active，长形容词用 most

zh: 我们的套餐晚上用电比白天便宜，所以晚上才洗衣服。
en: On our plan, power's cheaper at night than during the day, so we do the washing then.
alt: Our plan makes power cheaper at night than in the day, so we run the washing machine at night.
point: 比较时间要对齐：at night 对 during the day

zh: 换了一家网络公司，网速也没快多少。
en: We switched providers, but the internet isn't much faster than before.
alt: We changed providers, but our broadband's hardly any quicker.
point: 没快多少 → isn't much faster，much 修饰否定比较

zh: 这个月我们用的水是平时的两倍，可能哪里漏了。
en: We've used twice as much water as usual this month, so there might be a leak.
alt: Our water use has doubled this month, so we might have a leak.
point: 是平时的两倍 → twice as much…as usual

zh: 这个电工比上次那个收费高，但活儿干得仔细多了。
en: This electrician charges more than the last one, but he's much more careful.
alt: This sparky's dearer than the last one, but his work's far more careful.
point: 收费高 → charges more；仔细多了 → much more careful

zh: 修好以后，洗衣机的声音比以前小多了。
en: Since it got fixed, the washing machine's much quieter than before.
alt: The washing machine's way quieter now that it's been fixed.
point: 声音小 → quieter，不说 sound smaller

zh: 这种漆比便宜的那种耐用得多。
en: This paint lasts much longer than the cheap stuff.
alt: This paint's far more durable than the cheaper kind.
point: 耐用 → lasts longer，用动词 last

zh: 这个表格比我想象的复杂多了，填了一个小时。
en: This form was way more complicated than I expected. It took me an hour.
alt: The form was much more complicated than I thought, and it took an hour to fill in.
point: 复杂多了 → way more complicated than I expected

zh: 新驾照上的照片比旧的好看多了。
en: The photo on my new licence is much better than the old one.
alt: My new licence photo looks way better than the last one.
point: 好看 → better；licence 用英式拼写

zh: 在邮局排队花的时间比办事还长。
en: The queue at the post office took longer than the actual errand.
alt: I spent more time queueing at the post office than actually sorting things out.
point: 花的时间比…长 → took longer than，用动词 take

zh: 救护车来得比我想的快，不到十分钟就到了。
en: The ambulance came faster than I expected, in under ten minutes.
alt: The ambulance got here quicker than I thought, in less than ten minutes.
point: 来得快 → came faster；不到十分钟 → in under ten minutes

zh: 这场风暴比预报的严重多了，好多树都倒了。
en: The storm was much worse than forecast, and heaps of trees came down.
alt: The storm turned out way worse than predicted, and loads of trees fell over.
point: 比预报的 → than forecast，不必说 than the forecast said

zh: 被偷的那辆自行车比保险赔的钱值钱多了。
en: The bike that got stolen was worth way more than the insurance paid out.
alt: My stolen bike was worth much more than what the insurance paid.
point: 值钱 → was worth more than；赔 → paid out

zh: 今年做WOF比去年多花了不少钱，换了新轮胎。
en: My WOF cost heaps more this year than last year, because it needed new tyres.
alt: Getting a WOF was way more expensive this year, since I needed new tyres.
point: 多花不少 → cost heaps more than；tyres 英式拼写

zh: 走高速比走小路远一点，但更快。
en: The motorway's a bit further, but it's quicker than the back roads.
alt: Going on the motorway is slightly longer but faster than the back roads.
point: 远一点 → a bit further，far 的比较级 further

zh: 坐渡轮是进城最舒服的方式。
en: The ferry's the nicest way to get into town.
alt: Taking the ferry is the most comfortable way into the city.
point: 最舒服的方式 → the nicest way to…，比 comfortable 更口语

zh: 今年夏天雨比往年多，海滩都没去几次。
en: We've had more rain than usual this summer, so we've hardly been to the beach.
alt: It's been wetter than normal this summer, so we've barely made it to the beach.
point: 雨多 → more rain / wetter，不说 rain is more

zh: 新西兰的太阳比国内毒多了，一定要涂防晒。
en: The sun here is much harsher than back home, so always wear sunscreen.
alt: The sun's way stronger here than back home, so make sure you put sunscreen on.
point: 太阳毒 → the sun is harsh/strong，比较对象 back home

zh: 这是我走过的最美的一条徒步路线。
en: This is the most stunning tramp I've ever done.
alt: This is the most beautiful walk I've ever done.
point: 走过最美 → the most stunning…I've ever done

zh: 我觉得看书比刷手机放松多了。
en: I find reading way more relaxing than scrolling on my phone.
alt: Reading's much more relaxing than scrolling through my phone.
point: 让人放松 → relaxing，不是 relaxed；more relaxing than

zh: 这部比第一部差远了，太让人失望了。
en: This one's nowhere near as good as the first film. Really disappointing.
alt: This one's way worse than the first one. What a letdown.
point: 差远了 → nowhere near as good as

zh: 周末的电影票比工作日贵一点。
en: Movie tickets cost a bit more at the weekend than on weekdays.
alt: Cinema tickets are a little dearer at weekends than during the week.
point: 周末 → at the weekend；对比 on weekdays，介词别搞错

zh: 今年的年夜饭比去年简单，就我们三个人。
en: Our reunion dinner was smaller than last year's, just the three of us.
alt: This year's reunion dinner was simpler than last year's, with only the three of us.
point: 年夜饭 → reunion dinner；than last year's 别漏 's

zh: 婚礼比我们的预算多花了不少。
en: The wedding cost a lot more than we'd budgeted for.
alt: We spent way more on the wedding than we'd planned.
point: 比预算多 → more than we'd budgeted for

zh: 给新西兰朋友送礼，越简单越好。
en: When it comes to gifts for Kiwi friends, the simpler, the better.
alt: With presents for Kiwi mates, simpler is better.
point: 越简单越好 → the simpler, the better

zh: 我女儿现在英语比我好多了，还经常纠正我。
en: My daughter's English is much better than mine now, and she's always correcting me.
alt: My daughter speaks far better English than me now, and she keeps correcting me.
point: 比我好 → better than mine，比的是英语不是人

zh: 这家幼儿园比我们家附近那家贵一点，但老师更有经验。
en: This daycare's a bit dearer than the one near us, but the teachers are more experienced.
alt: This daycare costs slightly more than the local one, but the teachers have more experience.
point: 贵 → dearer（新西兰口语）；有经验 → more experienced

zh: 我爸妈过来住以后，家里比以前热闹多了。
en: The house has been way busier since my parents came to stay.
alt: It's much livelier at home now that my parents are staying with us.
point: 热闹多了 → way busier；since 后接过去时

zh: 这只猫比我们原来那只黏人多了。
en: This cat's much more affectionate than our last one.
alt: This cat's way clingier than the one we had before.
point: 黏人 → affectionate / clingy，长词用 more

zh: 给狗洗澡比我想的麻烦多了，弄得到处是水。
en: Bathing the dog is way more of a hassle than I thought. Water gets everywhere.
alt: Giving the dog a bath is much harder work than I expected, with water everywhere.
point: 麻烦 → more of a hassle，名词前用 more of a

zh: 这家宠物店的狗粮是全城最便宜的。
en: This pet shop has the cheapest dog food in town.
alt: You won't find cheaper dog food in town than at this pet shop.
point: 全城最便宜 → the cheapest in town，用 in 不用 of

zh: 说出来以后，我心里比之前好受多了。
en: I feel much better now that I've talked about it.
alt: Talking about it has made me feel a lot better.
point: 好受多了 → feel much better；now that 引出原因

zh: 他越解释，我越生气。
en: The more he explained, the angrier I got.
alt: The more he tried to explain, the more annoyed I got.
point: 越…越… → the more…, the angrier…，两半都用过去时

zh: 跟别人比，我总觉得自己进步太慢了。
en: Compared to everyone else, I always feel like I'm improving way too slowly.
alt: I always feel like I'm progressing more slowly than everyone else.
point: 跟别人比 → compared to everyone else；副词 slowly

zh: 他是我们团队里最有经验的人之一，有问题问他准没错。
en: He's one of the most experienced people on our team, so he's the one to ask.
alt: He's among the most experienced on the team, so you can't go wrong asking him.
point: 最…之一 → one of the most…，后面名词用复数

zh: 这两份报告里第二份写得好一些，我们就用那份吧。
en: The second report's the better of the two, so let's go with that one.
alt: Of the two reports, the second one's better, so let's use it.
point: 两者中较好的 → the better of the two，不用 best

zh: 在家办公的人越来越少，办公室又热闹起来了。
en: Fewer and fewer people are working from home, so the office is buzzing again.
alt: The number of people working from home keeps dropping, so the office is lively again.
point: 越来越少 → fewer and fewer，可数名词用 fewer

zh: 新版本的bug比旧版本还多，我建议先别更新。
en: The new version has even more bugs than the old one, so I'd hold off updating.
alt: The new version's even buggier than the old one, so I wouldn't update yet.
point: 比…还多 → even more…than；先别 → hold off

zh: 这台显示器的分辨率跟我家里那台一样，价格却只有一半。
en: This monitor has the same resolution as mine at home, but it's half the price.
alt: This screen's got the same resolution as the one I have at home, for half the price.
point: 分辨率一样 → the same resolution as；只有一半 → half the price

zh: 密码越长越安全，但也越难记。
en: The longer a password is, the safer it is, but the harder it is to remember.
alt: Longer passwords are safer, but they're also harder to remember.
point: 越…越… → the longer…, the safer…，主谓不能省

zh: 这家公司给的工资比我要的少，但福利比别家好得多。
en: This company offered less than I asked for, but the benefits are far better than elsewhere.
alt: Their offer was lower than what I asked for, but their benefits beat everyone else's.
point: 比我要的少 → less than I asked for

zh: 我宁可工资低一点，也不想每天通勤两个小时。
en: I'd rather take a lower salary than commute two hours every day.
alt: I'd sooner earn a bit less than spend two hours a day commuting.
point: 宁可…也不 → I'd rather…than，than 后用原形

zh: 推荐人的职位越高，拿到offer的机会就越大。
en: The more senior your referees are, the better your chances of getting an offer.
alt: Having more senior referees gives you a better chance of getting an offer.
point: 越…越… → the more senior…, the better；推荐人 → referee

zh: 这门课的作业量是上学期的两倍，我有点跟不上。
en: This paper has twice as many assignments as last semester's, and I'm struggling to keep up.
alt: There are double the assignments in this paper compared to last semester, and I can't keep up.
point: 两倍作业 → twice as many assignments as，可数用 many

zh: 我的口语进步得没有听力快，可能是平时说得太少了。
en: My speaking hasn't improved as quickly as my listening, probably because I don't practise enough.
alt: My speaking's improving more slowly than my listening, probably since I don't speak enough.
point: 没…快 → hasn't improved as quickly as；practise 动词英式拼写

zh: 在理工学院读书一般比上大学便宜，而且更偏实用。
en: Studying at a polytech is usually cheaper than uni, and it's more hands-on too.
alt: A polytech course usually costs less than uni, and it's more practical.
point: 偏实用 → more hands-on；比较对象 uni

zh: 新冰箱比旧的大不了多少，但耗电少得多。
en: The new fridge isn't much bigger than the old one, but it uses far less power.
alt: The new fridge is only a bit bigger than the old one, but it's much cheaper to run.
point: 大不了多少 → isn't much bigger than；耗电少 → far less power

zh: 比起天天叫外卖，我更喜欢在家自己做饭。
en: I prefer cooking at home to getting takeaways all the time.
alt: I'd rather cook at home than get takeaways all the time.
point: prefer + -ing to + -ing，to 后面也用 -ing

zh: 电动割草机比汽油的安静多了，也不用加油。
en: An electric mower's much quieter than a petrol one, and you don't need to fill it up.
alt: Electric mowers are way quieter than petrol ones, and there's no refuelling.
point: 汽油的 → a petrol one，用 one 代替前面的名词

zh: 这次房屋检查比上次严格多了，连烤箱里面都看了。
en: This inspection was way stricter than the last one. They even checked inside the oven.
alt: The inspection was much more thorough than last time, and they even looked in the oven.
point: 严格多了 → way stricter；比较对象 the last one

zh: 退回来的押金比我们预想的少了两百块。
en: We got back two hundred dollars less bond than we'd expected.
alt: Our bond refund was two hundred dollars less than we'd expected.
point: 少两百 → two hundred dollars less…than we'd expected

zh: 这间房没有那间宽敞，但采光好多了，还带独立卫浴。
en: This room isn't as spacious as the other one, but it gets much more sun and has an ensuite.
alt: This room's smaller than the other, but it's much sunnier and has its own ensuite.
point: 没那么宽敞 → isn't as spacious as；采光好 → gets more sun

zh: 他们家的派对一次比一次吵，昨晚闹到两点。
en: Their parties are getting louder every time. Last night's went on till two.
alt: Each party they have is louder than the last, and last night's went on until two.
point: 一次比一次吵 → louder every time / louder than the last

zh: 这条街的邻居比我以前住的地方热情多了。
en: The neighbours on this street are much friendlier than the ones where I used to live.
alt: People on this street are way friendlier than my old neighbours.
point: 比较对象要对齐：neighbours 对 the ones where I used to live

zh: 他家的树比篱笆高出一大截，把我们的阳光都挡住了。
en: Their tree's way taller than the fence now, and it's blocking our sun.
alt: Their tree's grown much higher than the fence, so it's taking all our sun.
point: 高出一大截 → way taller than

zh: 我们换了电力公司，用电量一样，账单便宜了三分之一。
en: We changed power companies, and for the same usage our bill's a third cheaper.
alt: Since switching power companies, we're paying a third less for the same usage.
point: 便宜三分之一 → a third cheaper / a third less

zh: 预付费套餐其实也不比月付的划算多少。
en: Prepay isn't really much better value than a monthly plan.
alt: A prepay plan doesn't work out much cheaper than paying monthly.

point: 比想象的 → than I'd imagined；kilometres 英式拼写

point: 比…还长 → longer than…itself，itself 加强对比

point: 人少多了 → way less crowded，less 也能修饰形容词

point: 等的时间 → the wait；比较双方要对等

alt: According to the dentist, my teeth have improved a lot since my last check-up.

point: 花的比挣的多 → spent more than we've earned

en: Compared to our old apartment block, the neighbours here are on another level. I'm not quite used to people being this friendly.
alt: The neighbours here are miles better than at our old apartment, and I'm still getting used to how friendly everyone is.
point: 好太多 → on another level；this friendly 表程度

zh: 网络公司我们差不多都试过了，说实话都半斤八两，没有哪家比哪家强多少。
en: We've tried just about every provider, and honestly, there's not much to choose between them. They're all much of a muchness.
alt: We've been through most of the providers, and to be honest, none of them is much better than the others.
point: 半斤八两 → much of a muchness / not much to choose between

zh: 客服说问题已经解决了，可网速反而比之前还慢，真是越修越糟。
en: They told me the problem had been fixed, but if anything, the connection's slower than before. Every time they fix it, it gets worse.
alt: Apparently it's sorted, but the internet's actually slower than it was. Their fixes just make it worse.
point: 反而更慢 → if anything, slower than before

zh: 电费都这么高了，我们暖气能不能少开点？多穿件毛衣总比收到账单吓一跳强吧。
en: With power bills like this, maybe we could ease off the heater a bit? Putting on a jumper beats getting a nasty shock when the bill arrives.
alt: Given how high the power bill is, could we go easier on the heating? A jumper's better than a horrible surprise when the bill comes.
point: 总比…强 → beats…；毛衣 → jumper

zh: 那个师傅说马上就来，结果拖了三个星期，早知道还不如自己动手。
en: The tradie said he'd be round in no time, then took three weeks. In hindsight, I'd have been better off doing it myself.
alt: The tradie promised to come straight away and turned up three weeks later. I should've just done it myself.
point: 还不如自己动手 → I'd have been better off doing it myself

zh: 这台洗衣机早就不行了，修来修去花的钱都快够买台新的了，越拖越亏，还是赶紧换吧。
en: This washing machine has seen better days. We've spent nearly as much patching it up as a new one would cost, so the sooner we replace it, the better.
alt: The washing machine's past it. We've almost spent the price of a new one on repairs, so let's replace it sooner rather than later.
point: 老了 → has seen better days；越早越好 → the sooner, the better

zh: 修好以后这扇门跟新的一样，你根本看不出来它之前坏过。
en: After the repair, the door's as good as new. You'd never know it had been broken.
alt: Since it was fixed, the door's like new, and you can't even tell it was ever damaged.
point: 跟新的一样 → as good as new

zh: 这件是贵了点，但质量比便宜货强太多了，长远来看说不定还更省钱。
en: It's a bit pricier, sure, but it's streets ahead of the cheap stuff, and it'll probably work out cheaper in the long run.
alt: It costs more, but the quality's way better than the cheap ones, so it might actually save money over time.
point: 强太多 → streets ahead of

zh: 网购看着便宜，但算上运费和退货的麻烦，其实未必比在店里买划算。
en: Buying online looks cheaper, but once you factor in shipping and the hassle of returns, it's not necessarily any better value than buying in store.
alt: Online seems cheaper, but by the time you add delivery and the pain of returns, it often isn't any better than shopping in person.
point: 未必更划算 → not necessarily any better value than

zh: 打折的时候人挤人，我宁可多花几块钱，也不想去凑那个热闹。
en: The sales are an absolute zoo. I'd happily pay a few dollars more to avoid fighting through the crowds.
alt: The sales are chaos. I'd rather pay a bit more than battle the crowds.
point: 宁可多花几块 → I'd happily pay a few dollars more to…

zh: 这家店环境一般，但论味道在奥克兰数一数二，比那些装修漂亮的店强多了。
en: It's not much to look at, but the food's right up there with the best in Auckland, and miles ahead of the flashy places.
alt: The place itself is pretty basic, but the food's among the best in Auckland and way better than the fancy spots.
point: 数一数二 → right up there with the best；强多了 → miles ahead of

zh: 我不是挑剔，但这次的牛排比上次差了不少，是不是换厨师了？
en: I don't want to be picky, but the steak wasn't quite up to the standard of last time. Have they changed chefs?
alt: Not to be fussy, but the steak wasn't as good as last time. I wonder if there's a new chef.
point: 比上次差 → not quite up to the standard of，委婉说差

zh: 这顿我来请，上次你帮了我那么大的忙，这是我起码能做的。
en: Let me get this one. After everything you did for me last time, it's the least I can do.
alt: This one's on me. You helped me out so much last time, it's the least I can do.
point: 起码能做的 → the least I can do，最高级惯用法

zh: 论纸面实力，对方比我们强一截，但我们一点也没让他们好过，最后只输了两分。
en: They were a cut above us on paper, but we gave them a real run for their money and only went down by two points.
alt: On paper they were the stronger side, but we pushed them all the way and only lost by two.
point: 强一截 → a cut above us；不让好过 → a run for their money

zh: 我跑得比以前慢多了，但现在反而更享受，不像年轻时那么在意成绩了。
en: I'm a fair bit slower than I used to be, but I enjoy it more now. I'm not nearly as hung up on my times as I was.
alt: I've slowed down a lot, but I actually enjoy running more these days, since I'm much less fussed about my times.
point: 不那么在意 → not nearly as hung up on…as I was

zh: 说实话，在场边看比自己上场踢紧张多了，至少在场上你还能做点什么。
en: Honestly, watching is way more nerve-racking than playing. At least on the pitch you can actually do something about it.
alt: To be honest, I find watching much more stressful than playing, because on the field at least you've got some control.
point: 紧张多了 → way more nerve-racking than playing

zh: 旅行的时候我总觉得别人的行程比我的精彩，大概就是这山望着那山高吧。
en: On holiday I always end up thinking other people's trips look better than mine. The grass is always greener, I suppose.
alt: Whenever I travel, everyone else's itinerary seems more exciting than mine. Classic grass-is-greener stuff.
point: 这山望着那山高 → the grass is always greener

zh: 跟去年那趟比，这次简直太轻松了，至少没误机，也没丢行李。
en: Compared to last year's trip, this one was a walk in the park. No missed flights, no lost bags.
alt: After last year's disaster, this trip was plain sailing. We didn't miss a flight or lose a single bag.
point: 跟…比简直轻松 → compared to…, a walk in the park

zh: 这么说吧，酒店的照片比真实情况好看太多了，我们到了以后真是哭笑不得。
en: Let's just say the hotel photos were rather more flattering than the real thing. We didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
alt: Put it this way, the hotel looked a lot better online than in person, and we didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
point: 委婉说差 → rather more flattering than the real thing

zh: 医生说我的情况没听起来那么严重，但还是早点处理比较好，以防万一。
en: The doctor said it's not as serious as it sounds, but it's better to deal with it sooner rather than later, just to be safe.
alt: According to the doctor, it's less serious than it sounds, but it's worth sorting out early just in case.
point: 没听起来严重 → not as serious as it sounds；早点 → sooner

zh: 去看医生总比自己上网查症状、把自己吓个半死强，网上查出来的永远是最坏的情况。
en: Going to the GP beats googling your symptoms and scaring yourself silly. The internet always jumps to the worst-case scenario.
alt: It's far better to see a GP than to look up your symptoms online and frighten yourself. The internet always assumes the worst.
point: 总比…强 → beats…-ing；最坏情况 → the worst-case scenario

zh: 我现在比以前更注意身体了，毕竟不年轻了，小心点总没错。
en: I'm far more careful about my health than I used to be. I'm not getting any younger, so better safe than sorry.
alt: I look after myself a lot better than I used to. I'm not getting any younger, so I'd rather be careful.
point: 不年轻了 → not getting any younger；小心为上 → better safe than sorry

zh: 他这个人越熟越有意思，刚认识的时候你可能会觉得他有点冷淡。
en: He's one of those people who grow on you. The better you get to know him, the funnier he gets, even if he seems a bit standoffish at first.
alt: He really grows on you. He might seem a bit distant at first, but the more you get to know him, the funnier he is.
point: 越熟越有意思 → the better you get to know him, the funnier…

zh: 不是说你的派对不好玩，只是我年纪越大，越喜欢安安静静待在家里。
en: It's not that your parties aren't fun. I'm just becoming more and more of a homebody as I get older.
alt: Your parties are great, honestly. It's just that the older I get, the more I like staying in.
point: 越来越宅 → more and more of a homebody

zh: 他的笑话一个比一个冷，但大家还是很给面子地笑了。
en: His jokes got worse and worse as the night went on, but everyone was kind enough to laugh anyway.
alt: Each of his jokes was flatter than the last, but people were nice enough to laugh along.
point: 一个比一个冷 → worse and worse，不说 one colder than one

zh: 那个投资的回报比银行高太多了，我听着就觉得不对劲，劝你还是离远点。
en: Those returns are miles higher than anything the banks are offering, which sets alarm bells ringing for me. I'd steer well clear.
alt: Returns that far above what banks pay make me really suspicious. I'd keep well away if I were you.
point: 高太多 → miles higher than；不对劲 → sets alarm bells ringing

zh: 跟朋友合伙买房听起来划算，但万一闹翻了，损失的可远不止钱。
en: Buying a house with friends might make sense on paper, but if things go south, you stand to lose a lot more than money.
alt: Going halves on a house with mates looks good on paper, but if it goes wrong, you could lose far more than just money.
point: 远不止钱 → lose a lot more than money

zh: 我们现在比刚来的时候宽裕了一点，但也只是勉强够用，离攒够首付还早着呢。
en: We're a bit better off than when we first arrived, but we're only just keeping our heads above water, and a house deposit's still a long way off.
alt: Things are a little easier than when we first got here, but we're only just getting by, and saving a deposit is a long way away.
point: 勉强够用 → keep our heads above water；宽裕点 → better off

zh: 这些表比我想的麻烦一百倍，说真的，写篇论文都比这个简单。
en: These forms are a hundred times more painful than I'd imagined. Honestly, writing a thesis would be easier than this.
alt: The paperwork is way worse than I expected. I genuinely think a thesis would be less work.
point: 麻烦一百倍 → a hundred times more painful than

zh: 在电话上等了一个小时，最后还是让我去网上办，早知道一开始就直接上网了，省得白折腾。
en: After an hour on hold, they told me to do it online anyway. I might as well have just done that from the start and saved myself the hassle.
alt: I waited an hour on the phone only to be told to go online. I should've done that in the first place and saved myself the grief.
point: 早知道不如… → might as well have done it from the start

zh: 跟国内比，这边办事是慢了点，但至少规矩清楚，不用到处托关系。
en: Things move a lot slower here than back home, but at least the rules are clear and you don't need to know the right people.
alt: Admin's much slower here than back home, but the rules are clear and you don't have to pull strings.
point: 慢得多 → a lot slower than；托关系 → know the right people

zh: 地震的时候我第一反应是往外跑，后来才知道那几乎是最不该做的事。
en: During the quake my first instinct was to run outside, which I later found out is about the worst thing you can do.
alt: When the earthquake hit, I bolted for the door, and only later learned that's pretty much the worst thing to do.
point: 最不该做的 → about the worst thing you can do

zh: 那次车祸其实没看上去那么严重，车是报废了，但人都没事，真是不幸中的万幸。
en: The crash looked far worse than it actually was. The car's a write-off, but everyone walked away, so it could've been a lot worse.
alt: It looked much worse than it was. The car's written off, but nobody was hurt, so we got off lightly.
point: 没看上去严重 → looked far worse than it was，反过来说

zh: 停电那晚我们点着蜡烛玩桌游，说实话比平时各自刷手机有意思多了。
en: The night the power went out, we played board games by candlelight, and honestly it was more fun than another evening glued to our phones.
alt: When the power was out, we played board games by candlelight, which beat spending the night staring at our phones.
point: 比平时有意思 → more fun than another evening glued to our phones

zh: 这辆车是老了，但开起来比很多新车还稳，真是宝刀未老。
en: It's getting on a bit, but it still drives better than plenty of newer cars. There's life in the old girl yet.
alt: The car's old, but it handles better than a lot of new ones. It's still got plenty left in it.
point: 比新车还稳 → drives better than plenty of newer cars

zh: 高峰期开车进城简直是自找罪受，我宁可早起一个小时，也不想堵在路上。
en: Driving into town at rush hour is just asking for punishment. I'd rather get up an hour earlier than sit in traffic.
alt: Driving into the city at peak time is a nightmare. I'd sooner set my alarm an hour earlier than crawl along in traffic.
point: 宁可早起一小时 → I'd rather get up an hour earlier than…

zh: 他开车比谁都小心，可偏偏是他被追尾了，你说倒霉不倒霉。
en: He's the most careful driver I know, and yet he's the one who got rear-ended. Talk about bad luck.
alt: Of everyone I know, he's the most cautious behind the wheel, and he's the one who got hit from behind. Typical.
point: 比谁都小心 → the most careful driver I know

zh: 这边的天气一天四季，出门最好多带一层，宁可带了用不上，也别需要的时候没有。
en: The weather here can do four seasons in a day, so always pack an extra layer. Better to carry it and not need it than the other way round.
alt: You can get four seasons in one day here, so take an extra layer. It's better to have it and not need it than need it and not have it.
point: 宁可带了用不上 → better to…than the other way round

zh: 那条线路号称轻松，结果比我们走过的任何一条都累，写简介的人肯定是超人。
en: The track was supposedly easy, but it was harder than anything we've ever done. Whoever wrote the description must be superhuman.
alt: It was billed as an easy walk, but it was tougher than any track we've done. The person who wrote that must be superhuman.
point: 比任何一条都累 → harder than anything we've ever done

zh: 现在让我选，我宁可住小木屋也不睡帐篷了，毕竟腰不如从前了。
en: Given the choice, I'd take a cabin over a tent these days. My back's not what it used to be.
alt: These days I'd pick a hut over a tent every time. My back can't handle the ground like it used to.
point: 不如从前 → not what it used to be；take A over B

zh: 这部电影的续集一部不如一部，我觉得他们拍完第一部就该见好就收。
en: Each sequel's been worse than the one before. Honestly, they should've quit while they were ahead after the first film.
alt: Every sequel's been weaker than the last. They really should've stopped after the first one.
point: 一部不如一部 → each…worse than the one before

zh: 我画画的水平跟专业的差远了，但这本来就不是重点，与其说是创作，不如说是放松。
en: My painting's nowhere near professional standard, but that's not really the point. It's more about switching off than producing anything great.
alt: I'm nowhere near as good as a real artist, but that's not why I do it. It's more about unwinding than creating a masterpiece.
point: 与其说…不如说 → more about A than B

zh: 本来对这场演唱会没抱什么期望，结果是我看过最好的一场，真是意外之喜。
en: I went in with pretty low expectations, but it ended up being the best gig I've ever been to. What a pleasant surprise.
alt: I wasn't expecting much, but it turned out to be the best concert I've ever seen. Such a nice surprise.
point: 最好的一场 → the best gig I've ever been to

zh: 礼物不在贵，心意最重要，你亲手做的卡片比任何买来的东西都珍贵。
en: It's the thought that counts. A card you've made yourself means more than anything you could buy.
alt: It's not about the price. A homemade card means more to me than anything from a shop.
point: 比任何…都珍贵 → means more than anything you could buy

zh: 今年过年就我们一家人，虽然没往年热闹，但安安静静的反而更有味道。
en: It was just the family this Chinese New Year. It wasn't as lively as usual, but in a way the quieter version felt more special.
alt: We kept Chinese New Year to just our family this time. Less lively than usual, but somehow the quiet made it more meaningful.
point: 没往年热闹 → not as lively as usual；反而更 → in a way…more

zh: 婚礼上的致辞一个比一个长，我差点睡着了，这话你可别跟别人说。
en: The wedding speeches went on and on, each one longer than the last. Between you and me, I nearly nodded off.
alt: Every speech at the wedding was longer than the one before. Don't tell anyone, but I almost fell asleep.
point: 一个比一个长 → each one longer than the last

zh: 我妈总说我小时候比我儿子乖多了，不过我怀疑她的记忆有点选择性。
en: Mum always says I was far better behaved than my son is, but I suspect her memory's a bit selective.
alt: According to Mum, I was much better behaved than my boy, though I think she's conveniently forgotten a few things.
point: 比儿子乖 → far better behaved than my son is

zh: 孩子长得比你想的快多了，一眨眼就上中学了，总觉得陪他的时间不够。
en: Kids grow up faster than you think. One minute he was starting school, the next he's off to college, and I feel like I've missed so much.
alt: They grow up so much quicker than you expect. It feels like yesterday he started school, and now he's at college.
point: 比你想的快 → faster than you think，泛指用 you

zh: 我们俩带孩子的方式不太一样，他比我松一些，不过我觉得这样正好互补。
en: We've got slightly different approaches to parenting. He's a lot more laid-back than I am, but I think we balance each other out.
alt: We parent a bit differently. He's much more relaxed than me, but I reckon that's why it works.
point: 更随和 → more laid-back than I am

zh: 别看它个子小，脾气比大它三倍的狗还大，连邮递员都怕它。
en: Don't let the size fool you. She's got more attitude than dogs three times her size, and the postie's terrified of her.
alt: She might be tiny, but she's feistier than dogs three times bigger, and even the postie's scared of her.
point: 比大三倍的狗 → dogs three times her size；脾气 → attitude

zh: 养猫确实比养狗省心，但它要是对你爱答不理的，你可别伤心。
en: Cats are definitely lower maintenance than dogs, but don't take it personally when she acts like you don't exist.
alt: A cat's much less work than a dog, but don't be offended when she completely ignores you.
point: 省心 → lower maintenance than

zh: 说是我们养狗，其实更像是狗在管我们，几点出去散步都是它说了算。
en: Honestly, it's less a case of us owning the dog and more the other way round. He decides when we go for walks.
alt: It's not so much that we own the dog as that he owns us. He's the one who decides when it's walk time.
point: 与其说…不如说 → less a case of…and more the other way round

zh: 我不是生气，更多的是失望，我以为你至少会先跟我商量一下。
en: I'm not angry, more disappointed, really. I thought you'd at least run it past me first.
alt: It's not so much anger as disappointment. I'd have thought you'd check with me first.
point: 与其说生气不如说失望 → not angry, more disappointed

zh: 我知道你是好意，但说实话，有时候少说两句比拼命安慰更有用。
en: I know you mean well, but sometimes saying less helps more than trying to fix everything.
alt: I know you're trying to help, but sometimes just listening does more good than offering advice.
point: 少说比安慰有用 → saying less helps more than…

zh: 现在回头看，那段经历让我比以前坚强多了，虽然当时觉得天都要塌了。
en: Looking back, it made me a lot stronger than I was, even though at the time it felt like the end of the world.
alt: In hindsight, it toughened me up, even if back then it felt like my whole world was falling apart.
point: 比以前坚强 → a lot stronger than I was
